import re

def slugify(s):
    s = s.lower()
    # Transliterate special characters
    transliterations = {
        '\u00f5': 'o',  # õ -> o

    for src, dst in transliterations.items():
        s = s.replace(src, dst)
    # Replace all non-alphanumeric with dash
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', s)
    # Strip leading/trailing dashes
    s = s.strip('-')
    return s

def slugify(s):

    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
